'''Bloodlight Sea''' was an area of the [[Karthakk system]] which belonged to [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and his [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Initially, the Bloodlight Sea was often a place for a business, a point often visited by an assortment of hagglers and thieves. Later, it was the main centerpoint for the war between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and Nym's vicious allies. A [[Space station/Legends|space station]] belonging to Nym was located in this region, as was a patrol of [[Nym Bomber]]s in the form of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]].
